title: Librarian action
description: A librarian at the desk enters a few details, and the library saves one record and shows what it saved. Registering a member, adding a tool, taking a return and reporting damage all work this way.
notes:
## How a use case uses the pattern

The use case links the pattern with `follows` and gives each setting its value as a header field, such as `required_input` or No input.

## Rules

The pattern's rules are records under it, and every domain that follows the pattern proves each one in its own tests. Pattern rules need proof only: a pattern rule test proves each in a domain that follows the pattern.

- `TL-PAT-LIBRARIAN-ACTION-R01`: an action missing its required input is refused and saves nothing (setting `required_input`).
- `TL-PAT-LIBRARIAN-ACTION-R02`: a successful action saves the record and shows it as stored.
